title: The Charter of Ash and Salt

hook.rumour: At Ebonheart's East Empire quays, two sets of customs manifests bear the Grand Council's stamp while cargo vanishes between Davon's Watch and Kragenmoor.
hook.notice: BY WARRANT OF THE GRAND COUNCIL AT EBONHEART — Investigators sought to audit the duplicate Inner Sea customs seals between Ebonheart, Davon's Watch, and Kragenmoor.
hook.context: Ebonheart is the uneasy hinge between the Imperial administration and the mainland Great Houses: whoever controls the Inner Sea customs seals controls ebony and glass tariffs across Stonefalls.

quests.title: Two Seals on the Inner Sea

stages.objective: Compare the duplicate customs registers at the East Empire Company Hall and Grand Council Chambers in Ebonheart
Inspect the unlogged night-lighters moored below the sea-wall at Davon's Watch
Question the Hlaalu toll-factors in Kragenmoor about the Ash-Mountain wax matrix

objectives.text: Compare the duplicate customs registers at the East Empire Company Hall and Grand Council Chambers in Ebonheart
Inspect the unlogged night-lighters moored below the sea-wall at Davon's Watch
Question the Hlaalu toll-factors in Kragenmoor about the Ash-Mountain wax matrix

consequence_detail.summary: The duplicate customs seals in Ebonheart and Davon's Watch are traced to a renegade syndicate operating between Kragenmoor and Fort Arand.

stages.objective: Track the smuggler mule-train north from Kragenmoor toward the lava-ridge at Fort Arand
Clear the renegade tariff-wardens holding Fort Arand and recover the Brass Stamp-Die
Carry the Brass Stamp-Die to the Redoran border-magistrates at Silgrad Tower

objectives.text: Track the smuggler mule-train north from Kragenmoor toward the lava-ridge at Fort Arand
Clear the renegade tariff-wardens holding Fort Arand and recover the Brass Stamp-Die
Carry the Brass Stamp-Die to the Redoran border-magistrates at Silgrad Tower

consequence_detail.summary: The Brass Stamp-Die is recovered from Fort Arand and verified at Silgrad Tower, revealing a Dwemer steam-vault cache under Ash Mountain.

stages.objective: Consult the Redoran archivists in Blacklight on the old Pact-era keys to Ash Mountain
Retrieve the Dwemer pressure-key from the reliquary vaults beneath Heimlyn Keep
Defeat the smuggling cabal inside the Ash Mountain steam-armature and seal the contraband sluice

objectives.text: Consult the Redoran archivists in Blacklight on the old Pact-era keys to Ash Mountain
Retrieve the Dwemer pressure-key from the reliquary vaults beneath Heimlyn Keep
Defeat the smuggling cabal inside the Ash Mountain steam-armature and seal the contraband sluice

consequence_detail.summary: The Dwemer contraband sluice under Ash Mountain is sealed and the conspirators' ledger naming their Ebonheart patron is seized.

stages.objective: Intercept the corrupt legate's mercenary rearguard beneath the stone colossi at Brothers of Strife
Present the Ash Mountain ledger to the Grand Council Chambers in Ebonheart
Witness the Imperial and Great House delegates ratify the renewed Inner Sea Customs Concord

objectives.text: Intercept the corrupt legate's mercenary rearguard beneath the stone colossi at Brothers of Strife
Present the Ash Mountain ledger to the Grand Council Chambers in Ebonheart
Witness the Imperial and Great House delegates ratify the renewed Inner Sea Customs Concord

consequence_detail.summary: The corrupt tariff ring is broken, lawful shipping resumes between Ebonheart and Vvardenfell, and the Grand Council honors your service.
